:::{#thm-epe-split-noise}
#### The pMSE of a prediction is the pMSE of the mean estimate plus the noise variance

Suppose that, given $\newpredvar = \predvar$,
the new outcome is $\newoutvar = \mean(\predvar) + \noise$,
where the noise $\noise$ has mean $0$ and variance $\varpar$,
and that $\newoutvar$ is independent of the random [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$.
Then, given $\newpredvar = \predvar$,
the [expected prediction error](#def-epe) of $\fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}$
is the [irreducible error](#def-irreducible-error) $\varpar$
plus the pMSE of $\fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}$
as an [estimator](estimation.qmd#def-estimator) of $\mean(\predvar)$:

$$
\E{\sqf{\newoutvar - \fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}}}
= \varpar + \E{\sqf{\mean(\predvar) - \fitproc\paren{\predvar; \trainset}}}.
$$ {#eq-epe-split-noise}

:::

::: proof
This is @sol-epe-split-noise.
:::
